voice.name: Open Sector - Sniper
voice.description: Calm, cold female marksman in her early thirties, low quiet voice barely above a murmur, precise clipped diction with a faint northern European lilt, unhurried and emotionless, dry dark humor, every word measured like a breath before the trigger, close-mic intimate near-whisper delivery.
voice.sample: Sniper. I see you, and you do not see me. Wind is low, the light is good. One breath in, half out, and then it is over. Tell me who, and I will tell you when.

fire.prompt: Single powerful scoped sniper rifle shot outdoors, sharp heavy crack with long rolling echo across a valley, medium distance, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Soldier moving stealthily on grass and dirt, soft cautious footsteps and quiet rustle of camouflage cloth, close, no music, no voice

reload.prompt: Precise bolt-action sniper rifle bolt cycled slowly, single brass casing ejected and tinkling on stone, bolt locked, close up, no music, no voice
